name: Reeves-Reed Arboretum Summer Camps
description_short: Weekly half day nature camps at a public garden in Summit for children from pre-K through rising grade 5, grouped by grade, with garden and trail walks, crafts, games and themes like animals, plants, birds and pollinators. Special weeks add a cooking camp and a full day dance and nature camp with BOLD Arts.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel 30 days or more before camp starts for a refund less a $65 administrative fee; no refund within 30 days.

sessions.name: Week 3: BOLD Arts Dance and Nature Camp (rising grades 1 to 5, 9 to 3)

notes: 2026 non-member prices: $300 a week for most themed camps (members $250), $335 for Food Explosion cooking camp, ages 5 to 10, in weeks 7 or 8 (members $285), and $480 for the BOLD Arts week (members $430). Member pricing needs a Family membership ($150) or higher; members register February 10, non-members February 24. Most camps run 9 to noon; Lunch Buddies adds noon to 1 for $75 a week, and children bring lunch. Children must be independent in the bathroom. No camp the week of June 29. 2027 not yet posted.
